title: Aye mere pyaase baraadar ho kaha
body:
BINT-E-ZEHRA KARTI THI RO KAR BAYAAN, AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
LUT GAYA GHAR JAL GAYE KHAIME SABHI, ABID-E-BIMAAR KI MASNAD JALI, AAG DAMAN MEIN SAKINA KE LAGI, QAFELE KO LEKE AB JAON KAHAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
NA ALI AKBAR HAI NA ABBAS HAI, AB NA QASIM HAI NA ASGHAR PAAS HAI, ZINDAGI AB HAR QADAM BE AAS HAI, HOGAYA HAI MUNHARIF SAARA JAHAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
ZEEST KA HAR LAMHA AB TADPAYEGA, ZULM KA YE SILSILA BADHJAYEGA, AB NA PARDE KA MOHAFIZ AYEGA, SORAHA HAI NAHER PAR SHER-E-JAWAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
THE RASAN BASTA JO HUM DARBAAR MEIN, SHARM SE THI THAR THARI BIMAAR MEIN, SAAT SAU KURSI NASHEEN DARBAR MEIN, HAYE KAISA HAI YE HUM PAR IMTEHAAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
KARTI THI BAALI SAKINA ROKE BAIN, AB KISI PEHLOO NAHIN AATA HAIN CHAIN, LO KHABAR AAKAR YA SHAH-E-MASHRAQAIN, KYA NAHIN SUNTE SAKINA KI FUGHAAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
DASTH MEIN AB HAI QIYAMAT KA SAMAAN, KHAAK PAR BAITHI HAI SAARI BIBIYAAN, AB NAHIN KOI HAMARA PAASBAN, BAANDHNE LAYE HAIN ZALIM REESMA
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
SHAAM KE RAHOON MEIN HOGA AB SAFAR, HAYE WO BAZAAR AUR HUM NANGE SAR, SAAT NAIZOU PAR SHAHEEDO KE WO SAR, KIS TARHA DEKHENGI ZAINAB YE SAMAA
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
KIS TARHA SUGHRA SE HAAL-E- DIL KAHOON, BAAP KA POORSA USSE KIS TARHA DOON, PUCHE ASGHAR KO TOH USSE KYA KAHOON, ZABT KA YAARA NAHIN HAIN BHAI JAAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
KARBALA MEIN LUT GAYA SAB GHAR MERA, ISTARHA LUT JAONGI SONCHA NA THA, LAB PE ZAINAB KE SOHAIL AKSAR RAHA, KISTARHA TANHA RAHOON TUJH BIN YAHAN
<<MINI>>
AYE MERE PYAASE BARADAR HO KAHAAN..
